_comment: Synthetic prophet/index.json exercising the reconstruction disclosure. Every origination_note string is transcribed VERBATIM from the producer (macro repo engine/prophet_bridge.py: RECONSTRUCTED_CHIP / RECONSTRUCTED_RECEIPT_EN / RECONSTRUCTED_RECEIPT_ZH) — it is row data on the wire, never copy this repo owns. Three rows on purpose: a reconstructed plan with a receipt, a live plan as the no-chip control, and a reconstructed plan whose date would not parse upstream so it ships the chip with no receipt. EVERY ROW IS PRODUCTION-SHAPED — state.geometry, what_to_do_now, profit_plan and thesis in both languages — because the detail panel renders all of them and a bare row would let a disclosure that pushes the action block off the first screen pass as green. The desktop centre column is height-locked, so panel height is a correctness property here, not decoration.

origination_disclosure.en: 2 of the plans now running were reconstructed after an outage
origination_disclosure.zh: 在跑的计划中有 2 只是中断后补记的
origination_disclosure.tip_en: The nightly run didn't finish over the weekend of 9 Aug 2026. These plans were rebuilt afterwards from the data as it stood that day, their windows are timed from it, and they are counted on their own in the record.

plans.thesis: Rideshare take-rate has stabilised for three quarters while insurance costs roll off the comparison base, and the group has been re-rating against a still-cautious sell-side. Dealer positioning is light above the first target, so a move through it meets little resistance from hedging flow.

origination_note.tip_en: The nightly run that would have made this pick didn't finish that weekend. It was rebuilt afterwards from the data as it stood on 9 Aug 2026, and its windows are timed from that date. Rebuilt picks are marked, and counted on their own in the record.
